主要内容: Impac Mortgage Holdings, Inc. held its annual meeting of stockholders on June 22, 2021. There were 15,850,515 shares of common stock present in person or by proxy. Proposal No. 1 involved electing a Board of Directors, with four nominees elected until the 2022 annual meeting. The proposal to approve executive compensation required a majority vote, with abstentions and broker non-votes not counted. The proposal to ratify the appointment of Baker Tilly US, LLP as the independent registered public accounting firm was approved by a vote of stockholders, with votes for 15,606,068 and against 185,796.
